articles.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts missiles as Aramco building in Riyadh is damaged, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Saudi Arabia has intercepted missiles targeting its capital and other regions. Falling debris damaged an Aramco building in Riyadh’s financial district. The Saudi-led coalition accused the Houthis of launching the ballistic missiles, and the Houthis claimed an attack in Riyadh. The Saudi Energy Ministry reported no casualties. Meanwhile, the UAE rescues 22 crew members after a cargo ship fire in the Sea of Oman. The incident highlighted ongoing risks to commercial shipping in the region. In Israel, President Isaac Herzog taps Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government, a setback for Netanyahu. Reactions across the Middle East are mixed regarding the political reshuffle.
